newsitem.title: FRANCE: Rhone to regroup units whatever RPR result.
newsitem.headline: Rhone to regroup units whatever RPR result.

text.p: France's Rhone-Poulenc will regroup its chemical, fibres and polymer operations into a single unit and list it on the stock exchange, whatever the outcome of plans to boost its stake in U.S. unit Rhone-Poulenc Rorer, Rhone chairman Jean Rene Fourtou said on Thursday.
A rise in the share price of Rhone Poulenc Rorer over $92 "could call the deal into question" Fourtou said, referring to the plan to buy out Rorer minorities for $92 per share.

"In any case, the regrouping will happen...the introduction onto the stock market is in my view an essential element...it is independent of the buy-out of the minority shareholders" of Rorer, Fourtou told a news conference.
Rhone Poulenc Rorer closed slightly over $79 per share on the New York Stock Exchange on Wednesday. -- Paris Newsroom +33 1 4221 5452
